source: CozyCrazyCraft Villager Quest & Reward Master Bible v0.2

rules.Implementation behavior: Each Alex's Mobs entry carries one of: observe, protect/coexist, tame/breed, material, controlled hunt, predator hunt, elite hunt. Weight the role before selecting the exact objective.
rules.Reason: Prevents the ‘every animal is a murder quest’ problem.

rules.Implementation behavior: Quest mob must match current macro-region + minimum authored band; cross-region only when the actual local biome supports it.
rules.Reason: Keeps gazelles in Sunscar and Froststalkers in Frostmarch.

rules.Implementation behavior: If a required species does not spawn within a reasonable quest radius, do not offer the quest. Prefer recent local sightings / biome capability checks.
Herd/flock creatures use census or small controlled-cull counts; solitary rare creatures use 1 target; Froststalker-style packs can use natural pack-sized objectives.
rules.Reason: Counts feel ecological rather than arbitrary.

rules.Implementation behavior: Routine kill pool excludes protected/peaceful-observation species unless the authored quest explicitly opts into hunting/culling.
rules.Reason: Lets the same gazelle support census, protection, or modest hunting without becoming spam.

rules.Implementation behavior: Prefer real Alex's Mobs drops/materials where practical. Use custom proof only when the real mob has no suitable item or when requiring the drop would create RNG frustration.
rules.Reason: Better mod integration and less fake quest clutter.

rules.Implementation behavior: Each named reward has a home region/profession and should not appear as generic random loot elsewhere.
Sunscar owns the boomerang identity. Greenveil may use javelins and other throwing/reach weapons, but should not casually dilute The Red Return / South boomerang identity.
Alex ecology jobs can build trust toward Frostmaw/Umvuthi/Sir Pumpkinhead/etc., but do not replace the authored boss chain.
East Jungle Abomination and South Ancient Remnant remain future-story flags until their isolated encounters are actually ready.

visibility_by_band.Suggested ecology visibility: 1 ecology quest in a 5-6 quest visible set; mostly observe/protect/odd naturalist, with occasional modest hunt.
visibility_by_band.Guardrail: Do not make the starter area feel like a wildlife checklist.

visibility_by_band.Suggested ecology visibility: 1-2 ecology quests; introduce real predator/hazard hunts and material commissions.
visibility_by_band.Guardrail: This is where regional fauna becomes part of expedition planning.

visibility_by_band.Suggested ecology visibility: 1 ecology major or elite contract + optional nonlethal discovery.
visibility_by_band.Guardrail: Strong native gear and named reward chains begin paying off.

visibility_by_band.Suggested ecology visibility: Rare elite ecology/horror/maritime contracts; mostly bespoke or trust-gated.
visibility_by_band.Guardrail: Dread should not merely scale up counts of gazelles/raccoons.

exception_policy.nether_and_end: Keep dimensional / exceptional Alex's Mobs out of normal Overworld village rotation until a dedicated chapter exists.
exception_policy.spawn_reality: Do not offer a species-specific quest unless current local evidence or biome/spawn capability makes the species reasonably available.
exception_policy.peaceful_species: Routine kill pools must not select peaceful/protected observation species unless the authored quest explicitly opts into a justified hunt or controlled cull.
